tdee_guide.title: Calculating Your Goals & Macros
tdee_guide.description: To gain, lose or maintain weight, you need to know your Total Daily Energy Expenditure (TDEE).
steps: 1. Calculate your TDEE using an online calculator (e.g. tdeecalculator.org).
2. For Fat Loss: Create a moderate 200-400 calorie deficit below your TDEE.
3. Set Protein Target: Multiply body weight in kg by 2.0 to 2.2g (or ~1g per lb of body weight).
4. Balance Carbs & Fat: Aim roughly for 40% Carbs, 30% Fat, 30% Protein, tailored to what keeps you feeling energized and satiated.

faqs.q: Do I need an air fryer?
faqs.a: Ovens work perfectly fine for all recipes (add 20°C/36°F if using conventional oven with no fan). Air fryers are faster, crisp more evenly, and save energy.

faqs.q: How do I prevent digestive issues on high protein?
faqs.a: Fibre! In particular insoluble fibre found in oats, berries, chia seeds, vegetables and whole grains. Aim for 30-40g of fibre daily to keep digestion effortless.

faqs.q: Why do my macros vary slightly from the book?
faqs.a: Different brands and regional variations have slight variances in calorie and macro values. The recipes use generic staple ingredients calculated via MyFitnessPal.
